openings.claim: Return may depend on fixed face datums/end stops, clamping after seating. Inside 90 mm, cut plywood into two connected corner saddles, captured stop offcuts and captive yokes; four bolts fasten saddles/carrier/stops, four fasten yokes. Recess nuts; cord/loops retain yokes/fasteners. Hand-open yokes without carrier dismantling, seat against two faces/stop, tighten; preserve marked-position frame angle.
openings.discriminator: Rival: tighter enclosure alone improves return; awkward trials establish neither explanation. If inconsistent seating explains tight-fit penalty, seat-then-clamp should give fewer misses than insertion under partial pressure with identical final tightening. Adjusted 18 mm rod should reach same datums. Persistent misses despite verified seating, or loaded drift beyond target, defeat repeatability or restraint respectively.
openings.probe: Check bolt reach, captive retention, saddle rigidity and full opening inside envelope first; fabricate within 100 minutes only if checks succeed. Compare two procedures on same joint: seat-then-clamp versus insert-under-partial-clamp. Each: five exchanges per original rod, then two replacing 19 mm with 18 mm; log exchange time/target return, seating gaps and loaded movement. Apply 10 N for ten seconds initially and after exchanges 9, 10, 12: four loads per configuration. At near-forty-second exchanges, twenty minutes leaves only 160 seconds logging/reset; abandon comparison as inconclusive if overhead cannot fit.
openings.uncertainty: Bolt lengths may not permit stacks/yokes; six plywood pieces may lack captured-stop material/stiffness; cord/loops may not retain everything. Hand tightening may lack restraint or damage/mark rods. Fabrication/measurement overhead may exceed budgets. No supplied observation establishes load success, exchange timing, retention or replacement tolerance.

decision: Bounded prototype probe; deployment requires checks passing. Keep rods unaltered: no drilling, adhesive or permanent marks; hand assembly/adjustment only; nothing falls free. Required: return within 2 mm target and remain during load after five exchanges each, every exchange under forty seconds. Unknown resources authorize no constraint relaxation.
